Then in sync_entries: `self.controller.state.borrow().fill_entries(&mut self.next_entries)` (or a controller method taking the buffer); `self.next_ids.clear(); self.next_ids.extend(self.next_entries.iter().map(|e| e.id));` use `self.next_ids.contains` in the two retain calls; and finish with `std::mem::swap(&mut self.entries, &mut self.next_entries);` instead of `self.entries = next_entries;`. The `widgets: HashMap<u64, Widget>` field is write-only: nothing in the file reads it (only init at line 572, `retain` at line 584 and this insert). Hoist the scratch buffer onto the render sliver: add `positions: Vec<usize>` to AnimatedCollectionRenderSliver (init `Vec::new()`). In list_layout: `let mut positions = std::mem::take(&mut self.positions); positions.clear(); positions.extend(range); positions.extend(self.entries.iter().enumerate().filter_map(|(index, entry)| entry.is_incoming().then_some(index))); positions.sort_unstable(); positions.dedup();` ... and after the children are built (take ownership via `positions.iter().copied()` in the children chain) store it back with `self.positions = positions;`. list_offset_for is O(position) and is called once per materialized child in list_layout (line 673), making layout O(n*m) with a HashMap lookup per step. Precompute the offset in one pass: since `positions` is sorted ascending and deduped, keep a running cursor in list_layout: `let mut scanned = 0; let mut cursor = 0.0_f32;` and inside the filter_map, before reading the offset, `while scanned < position { cursor += self.list_entry_extent(scanned); scanned += 1; }` then `let offset = cursor;`. Remove list_offset_for. The summation order is unchanged, so offsets are identical.

Do not materialize every snapshot to find one item. Iterate the live entries directly, tracking the logical index: `self.state.borrow().entries.iter().filter(|e| e.phase != AnimatedItemPhase::Outgoing).nth(index).map(|e| e.snapshot(index))`, where `AnimatedEntry::snapshot(&self, index: usize) -> AnimatedItem` builds `AnimatedItem { id: self.id, index, value: self.animation.value().clamp(0.0, 1.0), phase: self.phase }` and is also used by `snapshots()`. Live items have index equal to their logical position, so `index` is correct.
